comment: SPDX license expressions of the third-party Go modules linked into oec-check and oec-infra, for the SBOM of the tool image oi4/oec-conformance (oec-sbom -golicenses, ADR-0025 amendment C-107). Keyed by module and version: a dependency update fails the test TestConformanceGoLicenses of demos/internal/sbom until its license is reviewed here. Read from each module's LICENSE file; eclipse/paho.mqtt.golang is dual EPL-2.0/EDL-1.0 and taken under EDL-1.0 = BSD-3-Clause (ADR-0025 §7).
